subject: music
source_note: Topic structure follows the Edexcel GCSE Music specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Studying instrumental harmony and form models conventions a composition can draw on
Analysing classical phrasing and structure sharpens interpretation in performance
Vocal writing and word-setting techniques feed into students' own compositions
Film and stage scoring devices such as leitmotif inform composition choices
Fusion repertoire models how contrasting styles can be combined in composition
World and fusion idioms broaden the styles available for performance
Performing builds the practical instrument knowledge that makes compositions idiomatic
Both areas explore how music supports text, drama and narrative
